title: Keep your creativity alive
header_line: My analysis of one book on an entrepreneur's life. Not a summary of the book. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the author or publisher.

lines.text: When did you last make something without a machine's first draft?
A student said: monitor your own creative output versus what you rely on AI for. I have noticed a direct correlation to a mental laziness developing around creativity.
The analytical things are different, the student said: having a calculator doesn't mean you don't know how to do the equation. But if I use AI too frequently for creative things, I notice a reliance.
The flicker of creativity is one of the core essences of being human, the student said. If you are not creative, you are just following whatever you are told.
I asked: how do you create fertile ground for a child to maintain creativity? Are our educational systems valuing creativity, or is education getting more specialized and more robotic?

Liberal arts colleges gave you a well-rounded education, I said: you had to take an art class, a literature class. Today you have maybe three or four electives. I asked who is driving that curriculum, and answered: massive corporations that fund the programs.
A student said: they value creating workers, not free thinkers. Creativity is the free-thinking element of consciousness. They also said the same large corporations are behind AI.

Whenever you have momentum going one way, I said, it also goes the other way. People will say: is it a good idea for me to watch TV six hours a day, or should my kids be on their bicycles outside? All opportunities.
I said that what I care about is that my child loves learning. I tell the school: all I want is for my child to look at a book and be curious, and to come back from school happy.
How will you keep your own creativity alive?

exercise.title: Five minutes
steps: Write what you create without help.
Write what you hand to tools.
Write one creative habit you will keep.
Write how you would build fertile ground for the people you teach or lead.
Write what you want the children you know to love.

check.q: What did a student notice about relying on AI for creativity?
What did I say liberal arts colleges gave you?
What did I say I want my child to do with a book?

recap: Guard your creativity. Create fertile ground. Want curiosity more than grades.
